note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our data engineer job post drew 380 applicants in four weeks, but only 19 met the must-have requirements.

answers.common.decision: How to rewrite the post; the hiring manager decides who is screened in and any offer.
answers.common.materials: The post lists 14 must-have requirements. The hiring manager says only 5 of them are truly essential. The approved salary range is $120,000 to $140,000, and the post does not show it.
answers.people-hr.process: Job posting and applicant screening for engineering roles.
answers.people-hr.decider: The hiring manager decides who is screened in and approves any offer.
